glosses: ring (round piece of (precious) metal worn around the finger)

examples.text: Donne-moi un anneau si tu découvres quelque chose.
examples.en: Give me a ring if you find out anything.

examples.text: Elle retira son anneau et le lui jeta.
examples.en: She took her ring off and threw it at him.

examples.text: Elle a trouvé l'anneau qu'elle avait perdu pendant le voyage.
examples.en: She found the ring that she had lost during the journey.

examples.text: Nulle part on ne put trouver l'anneau.
examples.en: The ring couldn't be found anywhere.
